heartbeat.description: Causal Hypothesis Factory — deterministic edge scout, null library, frontier coverage map, and surprise queue. All artifacts are display-tier; no authority surfaces.

causal_scan.description: Cumulative distinct cells logged to the causal_scan TrialLedger family. Printed on every surface per CHF-R3 launder-proof multiplicity law.

frontier.value_heuristic_formula: score = UNEXPLORED_BONUS(10 if unexplored) + DATA_PRESENT_BONUS(5 if present) + ERA_BREADTH_BONUS(min(era_coverage_len, 4) * 1.0) - NULL_BASIN_PENALTY(20 if null_basin) - KILLED_PENALTY(100 if killed)

llm_lane.description: LLM brainstorm lane is INACTIVE. Phase-A gate requires: >= 1 operator-triggered cycle with >= 5 schema-valid cards filed, >= 1 candidate through exit (a) or (b), and zero guard violations. Then operator may flip auto_loop: true in config/causal_llm.yml.

data_absent_notes: entry_quality target family unavailable: replay_boarded.parquet not found (set REPLAY_BOARDED_PATH env var to runner-local path)

authority.description: CHF artifacts are epistemic infrastructure — causal-candidate screened, not gauntleted. No surface may rank, gate, size, or escalate any money-path decision.
